title: Artifact Contract
summary: Suite Manifest で manual-bb-harness v0.1.0 を定義。10個の Core Artifacts: phase_contract (Definition of Ready), feature_spec, test_model, observation_set, risk_register, manual_case_set, effort_plan, gate_decision, release_brief, execution_evidence。Policies: require_source_refs, require_oracle_per_case, require_traceability, degrade_on_missing_info, block_on_missing_critical_oracle。
